Important Notes
Please note when selecting and configuring your vehicle that the factory installation of additional equipment increases the actual mass of the vehicle and reduces the payload. The weight specified
on the following pages for the additional equipment ("packages", "features" and "options") corresponds to the additional weight compared to the standard equipment of the respective floor plan.
The total weight of the configured additional equipment must not exceed the manufacturer-defined maximum mass of additional equipment specified in the technical data. This is a value calculated
for each floor plan, with which Knaus Tabbert AG, as manufacturer, defines the maximum mass available for factory-installed additional equipment. The "mass in running order" specified in the
technical data is a calculated nominal value subject to production-related variations of up to ± 5%. These production-related tolerances of up to ± 5% are legally permissible and are separately
indicated in the technical data following the calculated value. Since these legally permissible tolerances directly affect the actual mass of your vehicle and thus also the maximum mass of additional
equipment, you should ensure that these are factored in when configuring your vehicle. The manufacturer-defined maximum mass of additional equipment is intended to ensure that the statutory
minimum payload for luggage and other accessories is actually available for loading after delivery of a vehicle by the manufacturer. If the actual vehicle mass increases through the selection of
additional equipment to such an extent that, calculated between the actual vehicle mass and the technically permissible gross vehicle mass, there is no longer sufficient loading capacity for the
transport of the permitted passengers and the minimum payload, you have, as part of the configuration, in principle (depending on the floor plan), the option to select a vehicle upgrade (uprating),
select a reduction in the number of approved seating positions during driving, and/or deselect additional equipment in order to continue the configuration. If this does not occur, the configuration
and thus also the ordering process for your vehicle cannot be continued. Detailed technical and legal information on the subject of "vehicle weights" can be found from page 2 onwards and at
"configurator.knaus.com".
